items.title: State Senate: Republicans keep a bare majority
items.text: Republicans lead or are unopposed in 29 of 56 seats, the minimum for a majority. Their closest lead is 1,668 votes, far more than late ballots usually move.

src.t: Georgia Secretary of State, unofficial results for every race, Nov 3, 2026

items.title: State House: Democrats gain majority
items.text: Democrats lead or are unopposed in 92 of 180 seats, surpassing the 91 needed for a majority. Their closest lead is 357 votes, well above the 0.5% threshold for a recount.

src.t: Georgia Secretary of State, unofficial results for every race, Nov 3, 2026

items.title: U.S. Senate: Jon Ossoff wins comfortably
items.text: Jon Ossoff leads Mike Collins by 18 percentage points, with a 2.4 million-vote lead. No recount needed, as the margin exceeds the 0.5% threshold.

src.t: Georgia Secretary of State, unofficial results: U.S. Senate
AP race call: FOX 5 Atlanta: "The Associated Press called the race for Ossoff at 7:55 p.m. EST."

items.title: Runoff for House District 151
items.text: Mike Cheokas (R) and Ethan Wolfe (D) are tied with 47.9% and 40.9%, respectively. A runoff is required as no candidate won a majority. The runoff will be held on Dec 1.

src.t: Georgia Secretary of State, unofficial results: State House District 151

items.title: Recount threshold for statewide races
items.text: A candidate trailing by no more than 0.5% of the votes cast can request a recount within two business days after certification. The Secretary of State must order a recount for races with a margin of 0.5% or less.
